_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are one of the world's largest producers of automobiles.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States or Europe, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford's current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2012 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are one of the world's largest producers of automobiles.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States or Europe, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford's current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2012 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 9.07x; +57% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.83; conservative 2yr -19%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.6%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.8%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +3.8%/yr (FY03-FY12 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +1128.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2014-01-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 9.07x (87.1% downside to Bear $2 / +9.6% upside to Bull $17) | Adj composite 2.88 vs market 1.05: gap +1.83 [UNDERVALUED] | +57% above the EPP floor $10 (7x FY13E $1.41) | Conservative 2-yr case: -19.3% total (-9.7%/yr) | At 11.0x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $21 sits above the BULL case; wholesale units +16.3% in Q3 2013, forward revenues +12.1% (no Q4 2013 revenue guide, Q3 2013 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
